query_snapshot: Which alloy and heat-treatment conditions does NASA SP-8119 identify as susceptible to stress corrosion in its material-compatibility discussion?
final_answer:
Evidence-grounded answer:

- NASA SP-8119’s material-compatibility discussion explicitly names aluminum alloy 2024‑T3 as susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- In the same scanned passage SP-8119 prints a sequence of heat‑treatment/temper designations (verbatim from the scan): "-T4, -T351 ;PH 15-7Mo RH950, TH !050; AM350 SCT850: AM 355 SCT850" and contains additional OCR‑garbled temper strings adjacent to the line that names 2024‑T3. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
